name: horizontal-scroll
title: Horizontal Scroll
blurb: Horizontal carousel slides triggered by vertical page scroll.
description: Full-page layout using Motion library and ReactLenis to create a horizontal scroll effect animated by vertical scrolling. Each slide has animated text overlays and images.
use_when: Portfolio hero sections or multi-slide storytelling layouts with premium scroll interactions.
avoid_when: Simple websites, mobile-first designs, or when scroll hijacking conflicts with accessibility.
a11y: Full-page component with semantic HTML structure; scroll-hijacking may impact keyboard navigation.
